mapper.select: select bai.id, bai.account_type as accountType, bai.ba_digital_rmb_company_id as companyID, case bai.account_type when '01' then bai.Ba_Company_Name when '02' then sc2.C_Name end as companyName, case bai.account_type when '01' then bai.ba_bank_name when '02' then bai.ba_digital_rmb_bank_name end as bankName, case bai.account_type when '01' then bai.ba_bank_account when '02' then bai.ba_digital_rmb_account end as bankAccount, bai.p_id as pId, pp.P_Name as pName, pp.P_Name as projectName, bai.state, bai.create_time as createTime, bai.create_uid as createUid, bai.create_uname as createUname, bai.state_time as stateTime from Bank_Account_Info bai left join Pre_Project pp on bai.P_Id = pp.P_ID left join SYS_Department sc on bai.ba_company_id = sc.D_ID left join SYS_Company sc2 on bai.ba_digital_rmb_company_id = sc2.C_ID where bai.state !=3 and bai.P_ID = #{pId}

select bai.id, bai.account_type as accountType, bai.ba_digital_rmb_company_id as companyID, sc2.C_Name as companyName, case bai.account_type when '01' then bai.ba_bank_name when '02' then bai.ba_digital_rmb_bank_name end as bankName, case bai.account_type when '01' then bai.ba_bank_account when '02' then bai.ba_digital_rmb_account end as bankAccount, bai.p_id as pId, pp.P_Name as pName, pp.P_Name as projectName, bai.state, bai.create_time as createTime, bai.create_uid as createUid, bai.create_uname as createUname, bai.state_time as stateTime from Bank_Account_Info bai left join Pre_Project pp on bai.P_Id = pp.P_ID left join SYS_Company sc2 on bai.ba_digital_rmb_company_id = sc2.C_ID
bai.state !=3 and bai.account_type = 2
and bai.ba_digital_rmb_company_id = #{pCompetentDepartment}
and likeCname(#{pCompetentDepartmentName},sc2.C_Id)=true
and sc2.C_Name like concat('%',#{pCompetentDepartmentName},'%')
